verdicts.reason: A drops the SOLSTICE logo entirely. Only an empty sliver of the dark header band is left at the top, so the brand is lost. The body copy is jammed right under the headline, 'Ships late June' is set almost as big as the CTA so the two compete, and everything is cramped. B keeps the logo band and the headline reads well, but the 'Reserve a Case' button is shrunk until it is illegible and pushed into a corner. 'Ships late June' and the legal text are also microscopic, while the oversized body copy runs against the left edge and pulls focus from the headline, so the CTA is buried and the hierarchy breaks. Both are broken. I pick A as slightly less bad because its CTA is still readable and prominent, but this is close to a guess.
